hero_title: My Journalist's Eye. Your Legal Expertise, Clearly Shared.
hero_body: Kandel Strategies helps lawyers share relevant expertise with reporters. Founded by former journalist Jason Kandel, the firm gets to know attorneys and their work, identifies stories where their perspectives fit, and handles media outreach. I also help firms turn their legal expertise into clear answers people can find through AI.
philosophy_quote: I start by listening for what an attorney knows deeply and cares about. Then I look for where that knowledge can genuinely help a reporter or someone trying to understand their legal options. The goal isn't to manufacture authority. It's to make real expertise useful, visible, and easy to verify.
services_header: Core Practice Areas: Legal PR, Media Relations & AI Visibility

services.title: Legal PR
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns complex matters into jargon-free language and creates opportunities for attorneys and executives to share their expertise.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Direct outreach to reporters and newsrooms to secure earned coverage in mainstream media and legal trades.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your public record, published work, and media coverage so tools such as Google AI Overviews and Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude cite your expertise accurately.

how_it_works_steps.title: 1. Discovery & Audit
how_it_works_steps.description: I analyze your current digital footprint and identify the key messages that make you stand out.

how_it_works_steps.title: 2. Strategic Outreach
how_it_works_steps.description: I connect you directly with top-tier journalists looking for your specific legal expertise.

how_it_works_steps.title: 3. Amplification
how_it_works_steps.description: I structure your media coverage to help your expertise stand out in search results and AI answers.

about_text: Jason Kandel is a legal PR strategist and former journalist, serving as the founder and principal of Kandel Strategies. He draws on over two decades of newsroom experience, including reporting for the Los Angeles Times, Thomson Reuters, NBC4 Los Angeles, and LAist/KPCC, to manage high-stakes legal PR and media outreach.

faqs.question: What services does Kandel Strategies provide?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies provides legal PR, media relations, and AI visibility tailored specifically for law firms, corporate legal departments, and executives.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies assist with legal PR?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies manages press coverage during active litigation and court proceedings. The firm drafts official statements, prepares trial attorneys for reporter interviews, and handles newsroom inquiries to protect client reputations and ensure accurate coverage during high-profile legal disputes.

faqs.question: What types of legal matters does Kandel Strategies provide media strategy for?
faqs.answer: I provide legal PR and media strategy for high-stakes legal disputes, including commercial litigation, intellectual property disputes, entertainment and sports matters, white-collar defense, employment suits, and regulatory investigations.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies work with clients?
faqs.answer: I offer flexible engagement options tailored to legal matters, including ongoing monthly retainers for firm-wide media relations and project-based support for active litigation.

faqs.question: Where is Kandel Strategies located and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: Based in Southern California, Kandel Strategies serves law firms, corporate legal departments, and individual attorneys across California and nationwide.

faqs.question: How can I schedule a consultation with Kandel Strategies?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a confidential consultation by using the contact form on this website or emailing jason@kandelstrategies.com.
